en.text: After this, the king of the children of Ammon died, and Hanun his son reigned in his place.

zhSimplified.text: 此后，亚扪人的王死了，他儿子哈嫩接续他作王。

zhTraditional.text: 此後，亞捫人的王死了，他兒子哈嫩接續他作王。

en.text: David said, “I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, as his father showed kindness to me.” So David sent by his servants to comfort him concerning his father. David’s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon.

zhSimplified.text: 大卫说：「我要照哈嫩的父亲拿辖厚待我的恩典厚待哈嫩。」于是大卫差遣臣仆，为他丧父安慰他。大卫的臣仆到了亚扪人的境内。

zhTraditional.text: 大衛說：「我要照哈嫩的父親拿轄厚待我的恩典厚待哈嫩。」於是大衛差遣臣僕，為他喪父安慰他。大衛的臣僕到了亞捫人的境內。

en.text: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun their lord, “Do you think that David honors your father, in that he has sent comforters to you? Hasn’t David sent his servants to you to search the city, to spy it out, and to overthrow it?”

zhSimplified.text: 但亚扪人的首领对他们的主哈嫩说：「大卫差人来安慰你，你想他是尊敬你父亲吗？他差臣仆来不是详察窥探、要倾覆这城吗？」

zhTraditional.text: 但亞捫人的首領對他們的主哈嫩說：「大衛差人來安慰你，你想他是尊敬你父親嗎？他差臣僕來不是詳察窺探、要傾覆這城嗎？」

en.text: So Hanun took David’s servants, shaved off one half of their beards, and cut off their garments in the middle, even to their buttocks, and sent them away.

zhSimplified.text: 哈嫩便将大卫臣仆的胡须剃去一半，又割断他们下半截的衣服，使他们露出下体，打发他们回去。

zhTraditional.text: 哈嫩便將大衛臣僕的鬍鬚剃去一半，又割斷他們下半截的衣服，使他們露出下體，打發他們回去。

en.text: When they told David this, he sent to meet them, for the men were greatly ashamed. The king said, “Wait at Jericho until your beards have grown, and then return.”

zhSimplified.text: 有人告诉大卫，他就差人去迎接他们，（因为他们甚觉羞耻），告诉他们说：「可以住在耶利哥，等到胡须长起再回来。」

zhTraditional.text: 有人告訴大衛，他就差人去迎接他們，（因為他們甚覺羞恥），告訴他們說：「可以住在耶利哥，等到鬍鬚長起再回來。」

en.text: When the children of Ammon saw that they had become odious to David, the children of Ammon sent and hired the Syrians of Beth Rehob and the Syrians of Zobah, twenty thousand footmen, and the king of Maacah with one thousand men, and the men of Tob twelve thousand men.

zhSimplified.text: 亚扪人知道大卫憎恶他们，就打发人去，招募伯·利合的亚兰人和琐巴的亚兰人，步兵二万，与玛迦王的人一千、陀伯人一万二千。

zhTraditional.text: 亞捫人知道大衛憎惡他們，就打發人去，招募伯‧利合的亞蘭人和瑣巴的亞蘭人，步兵二萬，與瑪迦王的人一千、陀伯人一萬二千。

en.text: When David heard of it, he sent Joab and all the army of the mighty men.

zhSimplified.text: 大卫听见了，就差派约押统带勇猛的全军出去。

zhTraditional.text: 大衛聽見了，就差派約押統帶勇猛的全軍出去。

en.text: The children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the entrance of the gate. The Syrians of Zobah and of Rehob and the men of Tob and Maacah were by themselves in the field.

zhSimplified.text: 亚扪人出来，在城门前摆阵；琐巴与利合的亚兰人、陀伯人，并玛迦人，另在郊野摆阵。

zhTraditional.text: 亞捫人出來，在城門前擺陣；瑣巴與利合的亞蘭人、陀伯人，並瑪迦人，另在郊野擺陣。

en.text: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose of all the choice men of Israel and put them in array against the Syrians.

zhSimplified.text: 约押看见敌人在他前后摆阵，就从以色列军中挑选精兵，使他们对着亚兰人摆阵。

zhTraditional.text: 約押看見敵人在他前後擺陣，就從以色列軍中挑選精兵，使他們對着亞蘭人擺陣。

en.text: The rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother; and he put them in array against the children of Ammon.

zhSimplified.text: 其余的兵交与他兄弟亚比筛，对着亚扪人摆阵。

zhTraditional.text: 其餘的兵交與他兄弟亞比篩，對着亞捫人擺陣。

en.text: He said, “If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you shall help me; but if the children of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will come and help you.

zhSimplified.text: 约押对亚比筛说：「亚兰人若强过我，你就来帮助我；亚扪人若强过你，我就去帮助你。

zhTraditional.text: 約押對亞比篩說：「亞蘭人若強過我，你就來幫助我；亞捫人若強過你，我就去幫助你。

en.text: Be courageous, and let’s be strong for our people and for the cities of our God; and may the LORD do what seems good to him.”

zhSimplified.text: 我们都当刚强，为本国的民和 神的城邑作大丈夫。愿耶和华凭他的意旨而行！」

zhTraditional.text: 我們都當剛強，為本國的民和上帝的城邑作大丈夫。願耶和華憑他的意旨而行！」

en.text: So Joab and the people who were with him came near to the battle against the Syrians, and they fled before him.

zhSimplified.text: 于是，约押和跟随他的人前进攻打亚兰人；亚兰人在约押面前逃跑。

zhTraditional.text: 於是，約押和跟隨他的人前進攻打亞蘭人；亞蘭人在約押面前逃跑。

en.text: When the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, they likewise fled before Abishai, and entered into the city. Then Joab returned from the children of Ammon and came to Jerusalem.

zhSimplified.text: 亚扪人见亚兰人逃跑，他们也在亚比筛面前逃跑进城。约押就离开亚扪人那里，回耶路撒冷去了。

zhTraditional.text: 亞捫人見亞蘭人逃跑，他們也在亞比篩面前逃跑進城。約押就離開亞捫人那裏，回耶路撒冷去了。

en.text: When the Syrians saw that they were defeated by Israel, they gathered themselves together.

zhSimplified.text: 亚兰人见自己被以色列人打败，就又聚集。

zhTraditional.text: 亞蘭人見自己被以色列人打敗，就又聚集。

en.text: Hadadezer sent and brought out the Syrians who were beyond the River; and they came to Helam, with Shobach the captain of the army of Hadadezer at their head.

zhSimplified.text: 哈大底谢差遣人，将大河那边的亚兰人调来；他们到了希兰，哈大底谢的将军朔法率领他们。

zhTraditional.text: 哈大底謝差遣人，將大河那邊的亞蘭人調來；他們到了希蘭，哈大底謝的將軍朔法率領他們。

en.text: David was told that; and he gathered all Israel together, passed over the Jordan, and came to Helam. The Syrians set themselves in array against David and fought with him.

zhSimplified.text: 有人告诉大卫，他就聚集以色列众人，过约旦河，来到希兰。亚兰人迎着大卫摆阵，与他打仗。

zhTraditional.text: 有人告訴大衛，他就聚集以色列眾人，過約旦河，來到希蘭。亞蘭人迎着大衛擺陣，與他打仗。

en.text: The Syrians fled before Israel; and David killed seven hundred charioteers of the Syrians and forty thousand horsemen, and struck Shobach the captain of their army, so that he died there.

zhSimplified.text: 亚兰人在以色列人面前逃跑；大卫杀了亚兰七百辆战车的人，四万马兵，又杀了亚兰的将军朔法。

zhTraditional.text: 亞蘭人在以色列人面前逃跑；大衛殺了亞蘭七百輛戰車的人，四萬馬兵，又殺了亞蘭的將軍朔法。

en.text: When all the kings who were servants to Hadadezer saw that they were defeated before Israel, they made peace with Israel and served them. So the Syrians were afraid to help the children of Ammon any more.

zhSimplified.text: 属哈大底谢的诸王见自己被以色列人打败，就与以色列人和好，归服他们。于是亚兰人不敢再帮助亚扪人了。

zhTraditional.text: 屬哈大底謝的諸王見自己被以色列人打敗，就與以色列人和好，歸服他們。於是亞蘭人不敢再幫助亞捫人了。
